name: journal
description: Capture a work session as a dated engineering journal entry written in the operator's own voice, saved to a local folder or committed to a GitHub repo

interface.shortDescription: Turn a work session into a dated engineering journal entry in your own voice.
interface.longDescription: Journal captures the current session as a dated markdown journal entry — what got built, what broke, what got reshaped, and decisions worth carrying forward — written in the operator's voice and saved to a local folder or committed to a GitHub repo.
defaultPrompt: Write a journal entry for what we did today.
Wrap this up as a journal entry.
